findings.title: Replace the procedural plate transcription with real shared overlay and property components
findings.evidence: The public API is only paint(Ui,facts), with no Id, state, update, measure, typed action or layout allocation. It paints literal Debug info/read-only/Close/× and always paints a focus gutter on index0. Five public diagnostic probes show pixels with no registered regions/focus, no navigation, facts beyond8 silently unavailable, empty data without Close focus, and a width65 view rendering no dialog. Matching coordinates/colors from the old INFO table establish mechanism provenance; names and width66 alone are not the basis for this finding.
findings.replacement_owner: Existing termrock-overlays Dialog chrome/layer/update/draw/measure plus termrock-controls PropsList/PropsState/PropsRow and real shared Buttons. Use the separately owned typed Dialog/Props adapter work; do not create another independent renderer.

findings.qualification: The suppression/clock/viewport mechanism is inherited and retained by the new InfoCard call sites at9552/9582; do not attribute all of it to93b.
findings.evidence: For paused LaunchRunning frame40, launch_dialog_on_page suppresses ui.layer while open_cockpit_info still opens and updates the Dialog layer. Real App probes in12 size/profile cases have no action bounds/hit/focus at frame40;12 corresponding frame41 cases have a real Close action. findings.replacement_owner: Always compose the real Dialog/Props body in the active ui.layer using the same IDs and configuration for update/layout/draw. Remove frame40/exact120x40 modal implementation selection and the page-paint suppression when its real replacement passes paired tests.

findings.title: Use terminal-cell text layout and clip fact labels to the component body
findings.evidence: label_cols and paint_at width use chars().count(), not terminal-cell width; labels are not truncated or clipped to card. A real public consumer with label界 loses it entirely because its Rect is1 cell. A100-character ASCII label paints X over the right border at(92,15) and outside the66-cell card at(93,15). The fixed8-fact take also has no scrolling state, so the ninth fact remains unavailable after End.
findings.replacement_owner: Existing PropsList measurement, shared termrock-text grapheme/cell-width/wrap/truncate tools, and resolved body clipping/scroll state. Preserve all view data; do not bound data by the former snapshot row count.

findings.title: Remove app-owned repainting and color inference after the shared component
findings.evidence: paint_info calls the new shared painter and immediately calls app recolor(66,11,0). That helper converts the card RGB inks and also recolors screen rain by RGB/index/background pairs;16/mono handling and NO_COLOR switches remain app-owned. The new component itself ignores custom accent/foreground/surface tokens and emits the same raw RGB title/focus/background in all4 capability profiles. These are source/real-buffer observations, not a claim about final encoded CLI frames.
findings.replacement_owner: Shared theme roles/state/profile rules used by the real Dialog/Props/Button renderers. Remove app-level RGB/pair correction and post-widget painting; do not rename it or move the inference helper into Termrock.
